content:

Module: Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting.
Open the lesson: https://share.articulate.com/s01WpXKAGFN1dft3QDlow#/lessons/leIXinEsOyEpjJYrcGTjkUlum6_Waiwt

These are VERBATIM machine transcriptions of the text visible in each screenshot -- Banner screens, forms and system dialogs. They are read off images, not authored prose: check the lesson itself before relying on a specific figure or field value.
